The user explicitly requested an executable now and publication alongside the GitHub Loss Lab, so each new version can be reviewed. That supersedes the earlier no-executable-before-final timing restriction for this development preview. It does not certify the physics, complete the programme, or waive final clean-machine checks. Online: Magnetics Studio. Windows: source-specific development prerelease. The existing portfolio Tools page links to both. Source, CI workflows and guards are in ChrisVer93/Portfolio; prior Loss Lab code/tests are preserved.

2. Physical models, equations, units and boundaries

2D static: -div(nu grad Az) = Jz; B = curl(Az ez)
3D static: curl(nu curl A) = J; B = curl A
Linear energy: W = 1/2 integral(B dot H) dV [J]
2D linear AC: -div(nu grad Az) + j omega sigma Az - sigma Edrive = Jstranded
Solid-current constraints: integral(Jz dS) = I_RMS [A]
Joule loss: integral(|J_RMS|^2/sigma) dV [W]
nu = 1/mu [m/H]; A [Wb/m]; B [T]; H [A/m]; J [A/m^2]

No new PDE, source current, material law, gauge, mesh, sparse solve, inductance formula or loss model is introduced. The browser adapter calls the exact existing reference solve/study/export functions. Their original bounded exterior, SI material/source definitions, 2D stack depth, 3D ideal-sheet winding and constitutive assumptions remain in force. Reversible nonlinear 2D and dedicated linear 2D AC retain their original limits; nonlinear/AC 3D and loaded field/circuit CLLC are still pending.

The native OpenMagnetics adviser in the Windows worker remains D001 component synthesis and rechecking, separate from FEM. Its nominal fit, reluctance/leakage, loss/temperature and functional-insulation limits do not establish manufactured safety or matched local-field accuracy. Browser algebraic residual or a successful frozen launch does not certify mesh/domain/source accuracy or commercial parity.

# Online and Windows development previews — R002 / v0.9.32

The user explicitly authorised a development executable and GitHub publication on 22 November 2026. This supersedes the earlier prohibition on building any application executable before feature completion. It does not establish final feature completion, industrial parity, signed release status or clean-Windows qualification.

## Online tool

The stable entry is https://chrisver93.github.io/Portfolio/tools/magnetics-studio/ and the portfolio Tools page links to it. The original interface, builder, independent winding/container/layer semantics, B-H digitiser, visualisation and field exports are reused. A pinned Pyodide 0.27.7 WebAssembly worker runs the actual original standard-library reference Python. No saved result or substitute JavaScript approximation stands in for a new field solve.

Supported online computation follows the original reference paths: 2D/3D static fields, reversible nonlinear 2D where supported, ordinary meshes, reference current/convergence studies, original 2D adaptation, dedicated linear 2D AC and frequency studies. Existing physical limitations still apply. Original native compiled PyOpenMagnetics design, Netgen/NGSolve and CAD are unavailable in this browser build and reported as unavailable to existing controls. The desktop download link remains visible. Core screening and designer requests are not falsely converted into reference FEM.

The initial browser mesh is additionally limited to 24,000 estimated cells; a real operation is terminated after 240 seconds. A dedicated worker preserves UI responsiveness. Cancellation terminates the actual worker and reinitialises Python for later requests. The main-page adapter retains only complete accepted results, the prior solved field/export and explicit job identities. Unsupported native and invalid static/AC requests fail preflight without replacing the accepted job. Cancellation also handles the asynchronous preflight/initialisation interval. Original FEM fields are not rewritten.

The engine packet contains exact original Python, inputs and required report-view resources, with source SHA256 values in version.json. Assets use tool-relative URLs under /Portfolio/tools/magnetics-studio/. The digitiser sample image and original report template/scripts are included. Initial browser runtime/assets require network access; this online preview is not advertised as an offline installation. Project data remains in the browser execution path. Export project JSON to move between browser domains or desktop. Browser local storage is separate for each origin.

## Windows tool

Successful main-branch builds publish source-commit-specific development prereleases under https://github.com/ChrisVer93/Portfolio/releases. Download MagneticsStudio-Windows-x64.zip, extract the complete folder and run MagneticsStudio.exe. Keep the console open while using the browser UI. The full folder, including _internal, is required. Python and installed native dependencies are bundled; the application launches a loopback-only original server and default browser. No installer or one-file frozen package is introduced.

The private --backend-worker entry executes the original whitelisted native worker in another copy of the frozen executable. Source execution retains its original Python child invocation. Resource paths follow PyInstaller’s actual __file__ layout. Existing Host/token/origin protections, source validation, isolated cancellation and native budgets are preserved. Native availability retains exact original version guards.

Pinned build dependencies are listed in requirements-desktop.txt. The preview includes PyOpenMagnetics 1.7.35, NumPy/SciPy, CadQuery 2.7.0 with OCP 7.8.1.1.post1, Netgen/NGSolve 6.2.2608 and MVB 0.6.12. The historical core-only screening bridge still expects CadQuery 2.6.1, so that separate route remains unavailable in this shared 2.7.0 bundle. No qualification pin is silently relaxed. The newer geometry-CAD route retains its own 2.7.0 guard. Metadata availability alone does not prove every optional native feature on Windows.

The first real Windows branch build ran on GitHub’s Windows Server 2025 runner. The exact frozen package passed original HTML/resources, actual project JSON roundtrip, a nonzero reference solve, actual OpenMagnetics design through frozen-to-frozen worker dispatch, genuine native cancellation, retained previous FEM field and JSON/CSV/VTK/HTML exports. Child PATH contained only Windows system directories; Python was absent from that PATH. The build runner still has Python installed for building. Proxy variables in the application point to a closed loopback port, while loopback HTTP is allowed; this is not a physical offline-host/firewall qualification. Browser/OS picker and clean Windows 10/11 without Python installed remain final-release checks.

BUILD_PROVENANCE.json and desktop-smoke.json accompany each tested package. SHA256.txt describes the published archive. Existing exact upstream notices are retained; the build also copies actual transitive distribution metadata/licence files into THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES. This is notice collection, not a completed legal/dataset redistribution audit. No mandatory prominent MIT co-branding is inferred.

QA-only Node dependencies are Pyodide0.27.7, jsdom26.1.0 and @napi-rs/canvas0.1.100. Browser CI additionally uses Playwright1.62.1 and its Chromium. They are not desktop application dependencies. Local DOM checks label synthetic viewport/file delivery; the Pages pipeline separately runs actual native Chromium controls, downloads/imports and screenshots before publishing.

The existing GitHub Pages workflow preserves Loss Lab regression checks, builds the preview from checked-in source, executes real Wasm/DOM and native Chromium checks, then deploys. A failed check skips upload/deployment and leaves the previous published site intact. The Windows workflow builds only on relevant source/recipe changes, tests the exact package, and publishes successful main builds as development prereleases. Report-only changes do not rebuild Windows. Branch build artifacts expire after 30 days; GitHub release assets are the durable user download.

An early native Chromium test checked designer availability before its asynchronous backend response. It correctly blocked publication. The final check waits for the actual capability state. An earlier local full profile became source_changed when final UI test/export resources were edited; its counts are not credited as final-source qualification. Legacy tests also regenerate evidence at historical paths; original bytes were restored, new outputs retained separately, and final discovery rerun in a detached checkout. Final source-bound receipts and actual CI evidence are recorded in the numbered report.

+"""Double-clickable desktop entry and isolated frozen native worker entry."""
+import json  #: Keep native worker requests/results finite and source-compatible.
+import multiprocessing  #: Register the standard frozen-process startup guard.
+from pathlib import Path  #: Read only explicit parent-generated worker paths.
+import sys  #: Distinguish the private worker entry from the normal local GUI.
+
+
+def main():  #: Reuse the original source application and its native worker in a frozen executable.
+    multiprocessing.freeze_support()  #: Prevent frozen multiprocessing helpers from starting another GUI.
+    if len(sys.argv)>1 and sys.argv[1]=='--backend-worker':  #: Dispatch an isolated operation instead of interpreting the executable as Python.
+        if len(sys.argv)!=5:raise ValueError('Invalid private worker arguments')  #: Reject incomplete native process requests.
+        from tools.backend_worker import execute  #: Preserve the original whitelisted optional-native implementation.
+        result=execute(sys.argv[2],json.loads(Path(sys.argv[3]).read_text(encoding='utf-8')))  #: Execute exactly the parent-written request through existing native preflight.
+        Path(sys.argv[4]).write_text(json.dumps(result,allow_nan=False),encoding='utf-8')  #: Publish only a complete finite worker result.
+    else:  #: Keep normal launch and existing command-line arguments source-compatible.
+        from studio import main as launch  #: Resolve original browser interface and bundled resource paths.
+        launch()  #: Start the actual local server and default browser.
+
+
+if __name__=='__main__':main()  #: Keep imported launcher helpers free of native work.

0001  """Isolate optional native libraries and make cancellation independent of native calls."""
0002  import importlib.metadata as metadata  #: Inspect optional package availability without loading native libraries.
0003  import json  #: Transfer finite model/result data through explicit files.
0004  import pathlib  #: Resolve only the trusted source worker script.
0005  import subprocess  #: Run CAD/FEM libraries outside the local GUI server process.
0006  import sys  #: Use the same explicitly selected Python environment as the server.
0007  import tempfile  #: Keep each job's data and logs private and disposable.
0008  import time  #: Poll cancellation and enforce a bounded job duration.
0009  from .sparse import Cancelled  #: Preserve the application's existing cancellation outcome.
0010  from .geometry_cad import CAD_PINS  #: Keep the new field-CAD qualification separate from the older OpenMagnetics version pins.
0011  
0012  ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]  #: Locate the worker inside this exact source checkout.
0013  PINS = {'ngsolve': '6.2.2608', 'netgen-mesher': '6.2.2608', 'PyOpenMagnetics': '1.7.35', 'OpenMagneticsVirtualBuilder': '0.6.12', 'cadquery': '2.6.1'}  #: Report tested versions without implying other combinations are qualified.

0016  def backend_status():  #: Offer lightweight source-environment diagnostics to the GUI.
0017      versions = {}  #: Preserve independent version checks per dependency.
0018      for name, expected in PINS.items():  #: Check both FEM and component-design/CAD dependencies.
0019          try:  #: Optional dependency absence is normal in the reference installation.
0020              installed = metadata.version(name)  #: Read package metadata only.
0021          except metadata.PackageNotFoundError:  #: Avoid importing a missing native package.
0022              installed = None  #: Keep absence explicit in the response.
0023          versions[name] = {'installed': installed, 'expected': expected, 'supported': installed == expected}  #: Distinguish detection from tested-version availability.
0024      cad_versions = {name: {'installed': versions[name]['installed'] if name in versions else None, 'expected': expected} for name, expected in CAD_PINS.items()}  #: Preserve the separate geometry adapter's expected versions without changing historical core-CAD qualification.
0025      for name in cad_versions:  #: Inspect the additional CAD-kernel package without importing its native modules.
0026          try: cad_versions[name]['installed'] = metadata.version(name)  #: Read actual installed distribution versions for this adapter.
0027          except metadata.PackageNotFoundError: cad_versions[name]['installed'] = None  #: Missing optional native packages disable only their own action.
0028      return {'design_transformer': versions['PyOpenMagnetics']['supported'], 'packages': versions, 'geometry_cad_packages': cad_versions, 'geometry_cad': all(row['installed'] == row['expected'] for row in cad_versions.values()), 'ngsolve': all(versions[n]['supported'] for n in ['ngsolve', 'netgen-mesher']), 'openmagnetics': all(versions[n]['supported'] for n in ['PyOpenMagnetics', 'OpenMagneticsVirtualBuilder', 'cadquery'])}  #: Enable component design independently of CAD dependencies while retaining every original backend pin.

0031  def run_backend(action, request, progress=None, cancel=None):  #: Execute only the two explicitly supported optional worker actions.
0032      if action not in ['ngsolve', 'openmagnetics', 'geometry_cad', 'design_transformer']:  #: Whitelist the isolated transformer designer alongside existing FEM/CAD workers without arbitrary execution.
0033          raise ValueError('Unknown native backend action')  #: Fail at the parent process boundary.
0034      status = backend_status()  #: Inspect the selected source Python environment before launching a native job.
0035      if not status[action]:  #: Never substitute a different backend silently when packages are absent.
0036          raise ValueError('Optional backend unavailable; see docs/NATIVE_BACKEND_SETUP.md and /api/backends for tested package versions')  #: Provide an actionable source-environment diagnosis.
0037      with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='magnetics_backend_') as temporary:  #: Give each job separate result and log paths.
0038          directory = pathlib.Path(temporary)  #: Keep all worker paths under the controlled temporary directory.
0039          source, target, logfile = [directory / n for n in ['request.json', 'result.json', 'worker.log']]  #: Define a fixed private protocol independent of user-supplied filenames.
0040          source.write_text(json.dumps(request, allow_nan=False), encoding='utf-8')  #: Validate finite JSON before native code sees it.
0041          with logfile.open('w', encoding='utf-8') as stream:  #: Capture native stdout/stderr without contaminating result JSON.
0042              command = [sys.executable, '--backend-worker', action, str(source), str(target)] if getattr(sys,'frozen',False) else [sys.executable, '-u', str(ROOT/'tools/backend_worker.py'), action, str(source), str(target)]  #: Use the private executable entry when frozen and retain the exact source interpreter path otherwise.
0043              process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=str(ROOT), stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)  #: Preserve isolated cancellation, complete logs and argument separation without shell execution.
0044              started = time.monotonic()  #: Measure timeout independently of the wall clock.
0045              offset = 0  #: Forward new log data once rather than repeating earlier output.
0046              try:  #: Guarantee process cleanup even if cancellation or a progress callback fails.

0002  import importlib  #: Resolve only explicitly whitelisted original metadata/model adapters.

0018      action=request.get('action','solve')  #: Preserve the original default reference solve.
0019      if action not in ACTIONS:raise ValueError('This native action requires the Windows desktop build; online preview runs reference solvers')  #: Never fabricate native adviser/CAD/FEM availability.

0029      if action=='mesh':return {'project':project,'mesh':mesh_public(build_mesh(project,progress)),'kind':'mesh'}  #: Return an actual original mesh, never a display-only placeholder.

0032      if action=='adaptive':return adaptive_solve(project,request.get('options'),matrix,progress)  #: Preserve original error-indicator/refinement semantics.

0034      if action=='ac_sweep':return frequency_sweep(project,request.get('frequencies'),request.get('options'),progress)  #: Retain actual frequency-dependent complex studies.

0053      if path in ROUTES:  #: Limit metadata dispatch to the actual supported source adapters.
0054          module,name,args=ROUTES[path];value=getattr(importlib.import_module('.'+module,__package__),name)(*[data.get(a) for a in args])  #: Call only a declared function with declared JSON argument keys.
0055          return {'specification':value} if path=='/api/builder/upgrade' else value  #: Preserve the original HTTP response envelope expected by the shared interface.
0056      raise ValueError('Unsupported browser API route')  #: Keep unimplemented endpoints actionable rather than silently succeeding.

0060      if not result or 'fields' not in result:raise ValueError('Solve a field model before exporting')  #: Never export an incomplete/cancelled candidate field.
0061      return {'json':lambda r:json.dumps(r,allow_nan=False),'csv':field_csv,'vtk':vtk,'html':report_html}[kind](result)  #: Preserve original units, field arrays and downloadable report content.

+"""Reference-only JSON bridge for the original interface inside a Pyodide worker."""
+import importlib  #: Resolve only explicitly whitelisted original metadata/model adapters.

+from .connections import require_static_sources  #: Reject AC solids on every static field action.
+from .analysis import solve_project,convergence,current_sweep,mesh_public  #: Reuse exact original field, study and export data.

+from .ac import solve_ac,frequency_sweep  #: Preserve dedicated reference complex-field solving.
+from .mesh import build_mesh  #: Preserve original mesh generation.
+from .export import field_csv,vtk,report_html  #: Reuse exact field export schemas and physical units.
+ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]  #: Resolve the actual virtual source tree, not remote files.
+ACTIONS={'mesh','solve','convergence','sweep','adaptive','ac','ac_sweep'}  #: Keep unavailable native code visibly outside browser capabilities.
+ROUTES={'/api/builder/catalog':('builder','catalog',[]),'/api/builder/upgrade':('workflow','upgrade',['specification']),'/api/builder/build':('builder','build',['specification']),'/api/builder/mas-export':('mas_exchange','export_exchange',['specification','options']),'/api/builder/mas-restore':('mas_exchange','restore_exchange',['packet','mode']),'/api/builder/mas-core-export':('mas_core_geometry','export_core_geometry',['specification']),'/api/builder/mas-core-apply':('mas_core_geometry','apply_core_geometry',['packet','mode']),'/api/builder/mas-material-export':('mas_material','export_material',['specification']),'/api/builder/mas-material-apply':('mas_material','apply_material',['packet','mode']),'/api/bobbin-draft':('bobbin_cad','draft_bobbin',['project']),'/api/turn-ports-draft':('turn_ports','draft_ports',['project']),'/api/turn-links-draft':('turn_links','draft_links',['project','turn_ports']),'/api/turn-links-plan':('turn_links','link_plan',['project','turn_ports','turn_links'])}  #: Share original builder/MAS/source-draft functionality through an explicit callable whitelist.
+
+
+def preflight(request):  #: Validate before the browser replaces its previous accepted job or result.
+    action=request.get('action','solve')  #: Preserve the original default reference solve.
+    if action not in ACTIONS:raise ValueError('This native action requires the Windows desktop build; online preview runs reference solvers')  #: Never fabricate native adviser/CAD/FEM availability.
+    project=validate(request['project'])  #: Validate a detached complete original FEM model.

+
+def run(request,progress=None):  #: Perform genuine numerical work inside the cancellable browser worker.
+    project=preflight(request);action=request.get('action','solve');matrix=bool(request.get('matrix',True))  #: Reuse authoritative physical preflight at execution time too.
+    if action=='mesh':return {'project':project,'mesh':mesh_public(build_mesh(project,progress)),'kind':'mesh'}  #: Return an actual original mesh, never a display-only placeholder.
+    if action=='convergence':return convergence(project,progress)  #: Execute the original complete reference mesh study.
+    if action=='sweep':return current_sweep(project,request.get('winding_id'),request.get('values'),progress)  #: Retain canonical electrical keys and actual bias-reference solves.
+    if action=='adaptive':return adaptive_solve(project,request.get('options'),matrix,progress)  #: Preserve original error-indicator/refinement semantics.
+    if action=='ac':return solve_ac(project,request.get('options'),progress)  #: Solve genuine reference AC fields.
+    if action=='ac_sweep':return frequency_sweep(project,request.get('frequencies'),request.get('options'),progress)  #: Retain actual frequency-dependent complex studies.
+    return solve_project(project,matrix,progress)  #: Execute unchanged reference 2D/3D field formulations.

0094                  elif action=='ac_sweep':  #: Route a bounded AC frequency study separately from static current and mesh studies.
0095                      result = frequency_sweep(project,request.get('frequencies'),request.get('options'),log,self.cancel.is_set)  #: Pass the complete frequency list and common controls to independently recomputed AC solves.
0096                  elif action=='adaptive':

0098                  else:
0099                      result = solve_project(project,bool(request.get('matrix',True)),log,self.cancel.is_set)
0100                  if self.cancel.is_set():
0101                      raise Cancelled('Analysis cancelled')
0102                  with self.lock:
0103                      self.result = result
0104                      if 'fields' in result:
0105                          self.field_result = result
0106                      self.result_job = job_id
0107                      self.job['status'] = 'done'
0108                      log('Completed')
0109              except Cancelled as e:
0110                  with self.lock:
0111                      self.job['status'] = 'cancelled'
0112                      self.job['error'] = str(e)
0113              except Exception as e:
0114                  traceback.print_exc()
0115                  with self.lock:
0116                      self.job['status'] = 'error'
0117                      self.job['error'] = str(e)
0118          threading.Thread(target=worker,daemon=True).start()
0119          return job_id

0013  <dialog id="guideDialog"><div class="dialog-head"><h2>Engineering workflow</h2><button data-close="guideDialog">×</button></div><div class="guide"><p class="eyebrow">MAGNETICS STUDIO 0.8 · INDEPENDENT IMPLEMENTATION</p><h3>Guided builder</h3><p>Click Builder and follow Core type → Dimensions → Material → Air gaps → Circuits → Windings → Interleaving → Nameplate/build. The same circuit and winding inputs drive 2D and 3D geometry.</p><h3>Circuits and independent windings</h3><p>A named circuit, such as Phase U, contains its own winding count and winding definitions. Primary and secondary have independent turns, current and phase. Only physical layers of one electrical winding carry the same series current. Reorder those layers per limb to define interleaving. Single, multilayer and interleaved arrangements are supported. Declared totals and odd final layers are checked.</p><p>Signed instantaneous current is the default excitation. Optional sinusoidal snapshot mode uses peak current × cos(snapshot angle + winding phase). It is a prescribed magnetostatic point, not a voltage-driven or AC circuit solve. Phase names do not impose phase angles.</p><h3>Material and image digitiser</h3><p>Select a material, enter linear μr, import numeric B–H data, or click Digitise from graph image in Material. Load a screenshot, enter graph limits/units/scales and calibrate A=(Xmin,Ymin), B=(Xmax,Ymin), C=(Xmin,Ymax). Trace one monotonic positive branch. Scroll zooms; Shift/right-drag pans. Move/delete points or edit their SI values. Invalid points block application; including (0,0) is an explicit assumption. Images stay in the local browser. Perspective photographs are not corrected.</p><p>Nonlinear reversible B–H is available in 2D. 3D remains linear; storing a curve in 3D does not activate nonlinear physics. Temperature/frequency labels select curve data explicitly; no automatic scaling or loss model is implied.</p><h3>2D and 3D windings</h3><p>2D supports full winding-block rectangles or separately meshed round/litz/foil/rectangular turn sections. A region carrying n turns has Jz = ±nI/A. Each winding has both + and − sections, preserving total ampere-turns. Round curves are faceted polygons. Litz is homogenized within each bundle, not resolved strand by strand. Stack depth scales linkage and energy; planar end effects are absent.</p><p>3D uses closed ideal rectangular current sheets at the packing-defined mean radius and axial extent. It computes 3D field end effects in a finite air domain. Winding display envelopes do not represent finite-copper eddy-current physics. Curved toroidal 3D cores and individual 3D wires are not implemented.</p><h3>Mesh, solve and inspect</h3><p>Preview and check fit, then use the model in the workspace, generate mesh and solve. Standard 3D budget is 44k tetrahedra; the explicitly selected extended budget allows 120k and may be slower. The builder shows a mesh estimate. Uncheck Matrix for field-only analysis. Failed convergence is rejected.</p><p>Use 3D field volume for magnitude colours, volume arrows, traced B paths, transparency and capped core surfaces. Rotating field slice remains a single plane. Streamlines are approximate postprocessing of elementwise fields. The solid model view provides part selection, hiding, cutaway and display OBJ export.</p><h3>Results and verification</h3><p>Linear inductance uses independent unit excitations. Native 3D section matrices are grouped by electrical winding, not by circuit container. Per-container winding-pair leakage assumes the selected other winding is shorted and all remaining winding currents are zero/open; the full coupled matrix is retained. Nonlinear points do not have a constant linear inductance matrix.</p><p>Check finer mesh and larger air boundaries. A tiny algebraic residual or energy discrepancy alone is not evidence of engineering accuracy. The closed outer boundary imposes zero normal flux and is not an infinite open boundary. Sharp-corner field peaks can remain mesh dependent.</p><h3>Save and reuse</h3><p>Save project JSON for the workspace, builder input JSON for the recipe, or a digitiser session including the source graph image. Changing raw generated geometry flags the recipe as stale; rebuilding does not infer manual edits. Previous v0.5 recipes migrate with their explicit geometry preserved. CSV, JSON, VTK, PNG and self-contained HTML reports remain available.</p><h3>Release boundaries</h3><p>Independent research software with limited validation. Linear 2D AC/eddy-current analysis is available with explicit solid-conductor current constraints and RMS phasors. No 3D/nonlinear AC, transient, core-loss, hysteresis, thermal, permanent-magnet, force/torque, arbitrary CAD or general 3D adaptive-meshing solver is added. Linear 2D local residual-driven refinement is available from Analysis; its indicator is not a certified error bound. The circuit hierarchy is a modelling definition, not a general electrical network solver.</p></div></dialog>

0001  """Publish the exact original interface/reference Python as a static GitHub Pages tool."""
0002  import argparse  #: Require one explicit static output destination.
0003  import hashlib  #: Bind every shipped engine/input asset to exact source bytes.
0004  import json  #: Package trusted Python/data for the browser virtual filesystem.
0005  from pathlib import Path  #: Resolve source and static output independently.
0006  import shutil  #: Copy original browser assets without reimplementing their behavior.
0007  ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]  #: Anchor all publication content to this source release.
0008  
0009  
0010  def build(destination):  #: Generate a complete, source-bound browser preview without a Python server.
0011      destination=Path(destination);destination.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);files={}  #: Preserve an explicit static output and trusted virtual source packet.
0012      for folder in ['engine','examples','data']:  #: Include exact original reference kernels, physical examples and builder/material inputs.
0013          for path in sorted((ROOT/folder).rglob('*')):  #: Traverse only declared source/data roots, excluding caches/native binaries.
0014              if path.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in path.parts and path.suffix in ['.py','.json']:files[str(path.relative_to(ROOT))]=path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')  #: Retain actual UTF-8 source/data with original virtual paths.
0015      for name in ['report.html','cad-view.js','field-view.js']:files['web/'+name]=(ROOT/'web'/name).read_text(encoding='utf-8')  #: Preserve the original offline report template and embedded view scripts inside the virtual source tree.
0016      for path in (ROOT/'web').iterdir():  #: Preserve original interface scripts/styles rather than create a mock UI.
0017          if path.is_file():shutil.copyfile(path,destination/path.name)  #: Keep exact original bytes for every reused browser asset.
0018      page=(ROOT/'web/index.html').read_text().replace('src="/','src="').replace('href="/','href="').replace('<head>','<head><script src="browser-runtime.js"></script>')  #: Make assets subdirectory-safe and install the worker API transport before original startup.
0019      (destination/'index.html').write_text(page,encoding='utf-8')  #: Publish the genuine original interface with only its transport/base-path integration changed.
0020      digitiser=destination/'digitiser.js';digitiser.write_text(digitiser.read_text().replace('/digitiser-example.png','digitiser-example.png'),encoding='utf-8')  #: Make the original digitiser image URL relative to the published tool subdirectory.
0021      shutil.copyfile(ROOT/'data/digitiser-example.png',destination/'digitiser-example.png')  #: Keep the existing digitiser example available beside other static assets.
0022      (destination/'magnetics-core.json').write_text(json.dumps({'files':files},ensure_ascii=False),encoding='utf-8')  #: Ship trusted original Python and inputs without any saved field pretending to be a new solve.
0023      manifest={'release':'0.9.32','runtime':'Pyodide 0.27.7 standard-library reference','native_backends_available':False,'source_sha256':{n:hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest() for n,text in files.items()}}  #: Make exact engine/source identity and the native capability boundary inspectable.
0024      (destination/'version.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\n');return manifest  #: Preserve reproducible per-release browser provenance.
0025  
0026  
0027  if __name__=='__main__':  #: Keep imports free of publication writes.
0028      parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__);parser.add_argument('output',type=Path);args=parser.parse_args();print(json.dumps(build(args.output),indent=2))  #: Build the requested static preview from this exact source checkout.

+"""Publish the exact original interface/reference Python as a static GitHub Pages tool."""
+import argparse  #: Require one explicit static output destination.
+import hashlib  #: Bind every shipped engine/input asset to exact source bytes.
+import json  #: Package trusted Python/data for the browser virtual filesystem.
+from pathlib import Path  #: Resolve source and static output independently.
+import shutil  #: Copy original browser assets without reimplementing their behavior.
+ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]  #: Anchor all publication content to this source release.
+
+
+def build(destination):  #: Generate a complete, source-bound browser preview without a Python server.
+    destination=Path(destination);destination.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);files={}  #: Preserve an explicit static output and trusted virtual source packet.
+    for folder in ['engine','examples','data']:  #: Include exact original reference kernels, physical examples and builder/material inputs.
+        for path in sorted((ROOT/folder).rglob('*')):  #: Traverse only declared source/data roots, excluding caches/native binaries.
+            if path.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in path.parts and path.suffix in ['.py','.json']:files[str(path.relative_to(ROOT))]=path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')  #: Retain actual UTF-8 source/data with original virtual paths.
+    for name in ['report.html','cad-view.js','field-view.js']:files['web/'+name]=(ROOT/'web'/name).read_text(encoding='utf-8')  #: Preserve the original offline report template and embedded view scripts inside the virtual source tree.
+    for path in (ROOT/'web').iterdir():  #: Preserve original interface scripts/styles rather than create a mock UI.
+        if path.is_file():shutil.copyfile(path,destination/path.name)  #: Keep exact original bytes for every reused browser asset.
+    page=(ROOT/'web/index.html').read_text().replace('src="/','src="').replace('href="/','href="').replace('<head>','<head><script src="browser-runtime.js"></script>')  #: Make assets subdirectory-safe and install the worker API transport before original startup.
+    (destination/'index.html').write_text(page,encoding='utf-8')  #: Publish the genuine original interface with only its transport/base-path integration changed.
+    digitiser=destination/'digitiser.js';digitiser.write_text(digitiser.read_text().replace('/digitiser-example.png','digitiser-example.png'),encoding='utf-8')  #: Make the original digitiser image URL relative to the published tool subdirectory.
+    shutil.copyfile(ROOT/'data/digitiser-example.png',destination/'digitiser-example.png')  #: Keep the existing digitiser example available beside other static assets.
+    (destination/'magnetics-core.json').write_text(json.dumps({'files':files},ensure_ascii=False),encoding='utf-8')  #: Ship trusted original Python and inputs without any saved field pretending to be a new solve.
+    manifest={'release':'0.9.32','runtime':'Pyodide 0.27.7 standard-library reference','native_backends_available':False,'source_sha256':{n:hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest() for n,text in files.items()}}  #: Make exact engine/source identity and the native capability boundary inspectable.
+    (destination/'version.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\n');return manifest  #: Preserve reproducible per-release browser provenance.
+
+
+if __name__=='__main__':  #: Keep imports free of publication writes.
+    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__);parser.add_argument('output',type=Path);args=parser.parse_args();print(json.dumps(build(args.output),indent=2))  #: Build the requested static preview from this exact source checkout.

+ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]  #: Bind models and resource checks to this delivered checkout.

+

+    def test_actual_reference_vector_fields_equivalent_in_two_dimensions(self):  #: Compare actual original direct and browser-adapter B fields in 2D and 3D.

+            project=json.loads((ROOT/'examples'/(name+'.json')).read_text());project['domain'].update(nx=6,ny=6)  #: Keep bounded real meshes, not manufactured saved numerical output.
+            if project['mode']=='3d':project['domain']['nz']=6  #: Solve an actual volume model in the spatial case.
+            direct=solve_project(project,False);adapted=bridge.run(dict(action='solve',project=project,matrix=False))  #: Execute both independent public entry paths on the same unchanged kernel.
+            self.assertEqual(adapted['fields']['B'],direct['fields']['B']);self.assertGreater(adapted['stats']['energy_J'],0)  #: Require exact physical vector-B equivalence and nonzero actual energy.
+
+    def test_actual_ac_and_static_rejection(self):  #: Preserve dedicated AC physics and reject incompatible static actions.
+        project=json.loads((ROOT/'examples/ac_square_2d.json').read_text());project['domain'].update(nx=6,ny=6)  #: Use a genuine finite-conductor diffusion fixture.
+        result=bridge.run(dict(action='ac',project=project,options={'frequency_Hz':10000}));self.assertGreater(result['stats']['ohmic_loss_W'],0)  #: Require an actual positive resolved AC loss.
+        for action in ['solve','adaptive','convergence','sweep']:  #: Retain every original static-action source gate.
+            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):bridge.preflight(dict(action=action,project=project))  #: Reject declared AC solids before a browser job is accepted.
+
+    def test_original_metadata_and_unsupported_native_boundary(self):  #: Preserve original builder data and explicitly report missing browser-native backends.
+        catalogue=bridge.rpc('/api/builder/catalog');self.assertIn('defaults',catalogue)  #: Read actual shipped original catalogue/default data.
+        spec=bridge.rpc('/api/builder/upgrade',dict(specification=catalogue['defaults']))['specification'];built=bridge.rpc('/api/builder/build',dict(specification=spec));self.assertIn('project',built)  #: Exercise the genuine original hierarchy and dimensional builder.
+        self.assertFalse(bridge.rpc('/api/backends')['design_transformer'])  #: Never advertise an unavailable native adviser on GitHub Pages.
+        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):bridge.preflight(dict(action='design_transformer',design_request={}))  #: Reject native requests rather than fabricate browser designs.
+
+    def test_static_output_binds_source_and_relative_assets(self):  #: Check generated application resource paths and exact original engine identity.
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:  #: Preserve historical source/evidence files during publication checks.

+            self.assertEqual(packet['files']['engine/analysis.py'],(ROOT/'engine/analysis.py').read_text());self.assertNotIn('src="/',page);self.assertIn('browser-runtime.js',page)  #: Preserve original PDE code and make every original script base-path safe.
+            self.assertFalse(manifest['native_backends_available']);self.assertTrue((out/'digitiser-example.png').is_file())  #: Keep explicit capability limits and original digitiser runtime data available.

+  workflow_dispatch:
+permissions:
+  contents: write
+concurrency:
+  group: magnetics-windows-preview
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+jobs:
+  windows:
+    runs-on: windows-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 45
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
+        with:
+          python-version: '3.12'
+          cache: pip
+          cache-dependency-path: magnetics_studio/requirements-desktop.txt
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with:
+          node-version: '22'
+      - name: Install pinned desktop dependencies
+        run: python -m pip install -r magnetics_studio/requirements-desktop.txt
+      - name: Build actual Windows one-folder preview
+        run: python magnetics_studio/tools/build_desktop.py "${{ github.workspace }}/magnetics-build"
+      - name: Test exact frozen application without Python on child PATH
+        working-directory: magnetics-build
+        env:
+          OMP_NUM_THREADS: '1'
+          OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS: '1'
+        run: node ../magnetics_studio/tests/desktop_smoke.cjs ./MagneticsStudio/MagneticsStudio.exe | Tee-Object -FilePath desktop-smoke.json
+      - name: Preserve exact source provenance and compress tested package
+        shell: pwsh
+        run: |
+          Copy-Item magnetics-build/desktop-smoke.json magnetics-build/MagneticsStudio/desktop-smoke.json
+          @{ source_commit = '${{ github.sha }}'; application = '0.9.32'; qualification = 'development preview; Windows runner API/native smoke, not clean-machine release qualification' } | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content magnetics-build/MagneticsStudio/BUILD_PROVENANCE.json
+          Compress-Archive -Path magnetics-build/MagneticsStudio -DestinationPath magnetics-build/MagneticsStudio-Windows-x64.zip
+          Get-FileHash magnetics-build/MagneticsStudio-Windows-x64.zip -Algorithm SHA256 | Format-List | Out-File magnetics-build/SHA256.txt
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        if: always()
+        with:
+          name: MagneticsStudio-Windows-x64
+          path: |
+            magnetics-build/MagneticsStudio-Windows-x64.zip
+            magnetics-build/desktop-smoke.json
+            magnetics-build/SHA256.txt
+            magnetics_studio/build/pyinstaller/MagneticsStudio/warn-MagneticsStudio.txt
+          if-no-files-found: warn
+          retention-days: 30
+      - name: Publish tested desktop development preview
+        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
+        shell: bash
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+        run: |
+          tag="magnetics-${GITHUB_SHA:0:12}"
+          gh release view "$tag" >/dev/null 2>&1 || gh release create "$tag" --target "$GITHUB_SHA" --prerelease --title "Magnetics Studio development preview (${GITHUB_SHA:0:7})" --notes "Magnetics Studio 0.9.32 preview. Source commit: $GITHUB_SHA. See bundled BUILD_PROVENANCE.json and desktop-smoke.json for exact Windows test scope. Full physical/commercial and clean-machine release qualification remains pending."
+          gh release upload "$tag" magnetics-build/MagneticsStudio-Windows-x64.zip magnetics-build/SHA256.txt --clobber
